title: Actual commands — Nextflow port
subtitle: The script: block of each module. Tools and options match the on-premise pipeline; what changed is the wiring — job submission, chunking, resume and failure detection.

entries.name: Launch
entries.note: The kingdom branch is one file: conf/kingdom/{eukaryota|bacteria|archaea|virus}.config.

entries.name: TRIMMOMATIC  —  default
entries.note: The log is checked for java.io.EOFException — Trimmomatic returns exit 0 on truncated input.

entries.name: TRIM_GALORE  —  --trim_program trim_galore
cmd: mv *_val_1.fq ${id}_1.trim.fastq   # match the Trimmomatic module's output names

entries.name: CUTADAPT  —  new in the port (--trim_program cutadapt)
entries.note: The on-premise scripts offer only trimmomatic and trim_galore; cutadapt exists there solely as TrimGalore's engine. Here it is a process you can select, which is why it has a station on this map and none on the on-premise one.

entries.name: SEQ_STATS · FASTQC  —  raw and trimmed, both
entries.note: The stage channel carries raw and trimmed, so the same process runs twice.

entries.name: RNAQC  —  not ported yet
cmd: # order-level QC in the BTS layer; the port does not cover it yet.
entries.note: Shown on the map so the two diagrams line up station for station.

entries.name: Assembly grouping  —  one samplesheet column
cmd: same assembly_group -> grouped by groupTuple  (original merge yes)
a different group per sample -> assembled separately (original merge no)
only some sharing a group -> subset merge
entries.note: This one column replaces the merge switch plus the asm[N] keys. Bad combinations are rejected before the workflow starts.

entries.name: MERGE_FASTQ
entries.note: A group holding one sample is filtered out by branch, so the process never runs for it (the original's ln -s / pass case).

entries.name: TRINITY
entries.note: --max_memory now comes from task.memory, so it cannot disagree with the instance size.

entries.name: UNIGENE
entries.note: -M is now params.cdhit_memory. It stays at the original 0 until the identity check is finished.

entries.name: RSEM_INDEX · RSEM
entries.note: Groups entering through assembly_fasta join here. Quantification always runs; it is never skipped.

entries.name: BUSCO
entries.note: A relative -l is read as a lineage name and fails offline, so it is resolved to an absolute path.

entries.name: BLAST_CHUNK  —  a chunk is a task
entries.note: No wrapper and no re-submitted sub-jobs. -resume works per chunk, so only the failed chunk is redone.

entries.name: KOFAMSCAN_CHUNK
entries.note: Wrapped in a ko_annotation subworkflow because KofamKOALA will replace it.

entries.name: InterProScan  —  not ported yet
cmd: # the port does not run this step.
# when it is added: params.interproscan (default false)
entries.note: The original has no way to switch it off, so it ran every time regardless of the db list. Measured 4h25m.
